Media Type: Silicon Carbide

Cap off any water lines to prevent media from getting inside the lines. Mask off any areas that must retain a fine finish ( o-ring groves, sealing surfaces, etc. ). DO NOT BEAD BLAST THE SCREWS FROM THE MRS. Blast all surfaces of the MRS to remove all visible contamination. Do not remove parts from cabinet until all gross contamination has been removed. Extra care must be taken with the ceramic and graphite parts due to the fact that they can be damaged very easily. Parts must then be blown off with the air hose prior to being removed from the cabinet.

div.root:

Media Type: Silicon Carbide
Grit Size: 150 grit
Nozzle: Pressure
Cap off any water lines to prevent media from getting inside the lines. Mask off any areas that must retain a fine finish ( o-ring groves, sealing surfaces, etc. ). DO NOT BEAD BLAST THE SCREWS FROM THE MRS. Blast all surfaces of the MRS to remove all visible contamination. Do not remove parts from cabinet until all gross contamination has been removed. Extra care must be taken with the ceramic and graphite parts due to the fact that they can be damaged very easily. Parts must then be blown off with the air hose prior to being removed from the cabinet.
